items.title: What Is Lumen Technologies (LUMN) Doing To Simplify AI Connectivity For Enterprises?
items.summary: Lumen Technologies (NasdaqGS:LUMN) has expanded its collaboration with Microsoft to support enterprise adoption of AI on Azure. The enlarged partnership ties Lumen’s cloud networking and application connectivity tools directly into Microsoft Azure cloud and AI services. Both companies plan joint work on future network modernization projects intended to simplify how enterprises connect data and applications for AI use.
